challenge: Does server.js or Express have a redirect or alias for /api/stock-outs?
analysis: Checked server.js line 112: only app.use('/api/stock-out', stockOutRoutes) is registered. No alias exists for /api/stock-outs. Request hits 404 handler directly.

challenge: Is 'chala' a profanity or required for censorship?
analysis: In Uzbek linguistic context, 'chala' means incomplete/unfinished. It is an ordinary word used in manufacturing, warehousing, and inventory (e.g. 'chala tayyor'). It has no vulgar connotation on its own.

challenge: Does express-validator ensure quantity and price are always supplied in update requests?
analysis: While route middleware checks min value when present, in standard REST update patterns or internal calls where fields may be omitted, parseFloat(undefined) yields NaN and causes crashes. Defensive coding requires falling back to existing record values.

challenge: Does auditLog ever log 'stock_in' or 'stock_out' as the module name?
analysis: Checked stockIn.routes.js and stockOut.routes.js: auditLog is invoked with ('stock', 'in') and ('stock', 'out'). The module name is strictly 'stock'. The filter in audit-logs.ejs never matches.

challenge: Does frontend api.js handle non-JSON responses from 404?
analysis: api.js has defensive parsing, but standard REST conventions mandate that /api/* endpoints return JSON objects with { success: false, error: ... } rather than full HTML documents.

challenge: Does Prisma throw an exception when skip is negative?
analysis: Empirically tested in Node.js runtime: Prisma engine immediately throws PrismaClientUnknownRequestError: AssertionError('Invalid value for skip argument: Value can only be positive, found: -10'), which triggers an unhandled 500 error.

challenge: Does the app strictly require cookie auth or is Bearer token sufficient?
analysis: Bearer token works for client-side API requests, but middleware/auth.js includes cookie fallback code that is rendered inert because login/logout never sets or clears the cookie. Supporting both completes the contract.

challenge: Is client-side filtering on 20 items acceptable for status?
analysis: When total products exceed 20, filtering only the current page in-memory gives misleading zero results if all matching items reside on later pages.
